audience: teams that check, complete or geocode New Zealand and Australian addresses

useCases.title: Verify a customer address before saving it
useCases.text: Check one full NZ or AU address, even with typos, against the Addressfinder database. Read whether it matched and the matched address.

useCases.title: Complete an address while a user types
useCases.text: Search partial NZ or AU addresses with autocomplete. Load the metadata of the chosen result for its parsed parts, postcode and coordinates.

useCases.title: Find the nearest NZ addresses to a map pin
useCases.text: Give a GPS point to get the nearest NZ addresses, ordered by distance. Load the metadata of the address you choose.

useCases.title: Find the correct street or suburb name
useCases.text: Search NZ or AU streets, suburbs, cities, regions and states. Load the metadata of the chosen location for its full name and coordinates.
